name: MVL Benchmark Library
description: Reference specifications and implementations of multi-valued logic designs (arithmetic-logic units over Z/k^nZ and GF(q)[x]/(x^n)) in C, Python, Verilog and VHDL, each checked against an independent reference model (v1.1) and published with its verification record. 56 specifications, 654 implementations (432 verified). Benchmark format v1.0. Website with browsing, per-file verification logs and submission pipeline: https://llm-mvl.com
